name: Receipt Reaper
tagline: Finds the software you forgot you were paying for and scores how dead it is
description: Reads back through your Gmail for services you signed up for and then quietly stopped opening, and rates each one on how dormant it has really gone. What comes back is a readable write-up rather than a spreadsheet, pointing at the way out where there is one. It never cancels anything for you.
author: RealJBMangum
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
